body_text:
Fundamental theorem of algebra. Every nonconstant polynomial with
complex coefficients has a complex root. Equivalently, every
degree-$n$ polynomial splits over $\mathbb{C}$ into $n$ linear
factors counted with multiplicity. This is what it means for
$\mathbb{C}$ to be algebraically closed.
